rules.statement: The measure may be paid for arable, grassland, wine, orchard and hop areas.

conditions.expression: parcel.land_use is arable or grassland, or parcel is a special crop of category orchard, vineyard or hop
conditions.description: The parcel belongs to an eligible land-use class.

result.description: The parcel is in scope for o6_2.

rules.statement: The o6_2 contract is multi-year and runs through 31 December 2028; starts in 2023, 2024 and 2025 run for six, five and four years respectively.

conditions.expression: contract_start_year in {2023, 2024, 2025}
conditions.description: The measure was entered in an allowed entry year.

result.description: The contractual end date is 2028-12-31.

rules.statement: Participation in UBB (1A) is mandatory at the same time as o6_2.

conditions.expression: program.o6_1a.participates == true
conditions.description: The mandatory UBB combination is active.

result.description: o6_2 has its required UBB combination.

rules.statement: A farm is animal-holding when at least 0.30 RGVE per hectare of all fodder area is held.

conditions.expression: total_rgve / (grassland_area_ha + arable_fodder_area_ha) >= 0.30
conditions.description: RGVE is divided by the sum of grassland and arable fodder area.

result.description: The farm is classified as animal-holding for premium purposes.

rules.statement: Arable fodder consists of Futtergräser, Wechselwiese, Kleegras, Klee, Luzerne, Ackerweide and sonstiges Feldfutter.

conditions.expression: parcel.crop.crop_name is in the closed arable-fodder list
conditions.description: The crop name is one of the listed fodder uses.

result.description: The parcel counts as arable fodder for animal-status and premium rules.

rules.statement: RGVE must be calculated using the complete Anhang A conversion table, including age and size classes.

conditions.expression: each animal category resolves to a data.rgve_key entry
conditions.description: Every counted animal group has a table factor.

result.description: Animal counts are multiplied by the applicable RGVE factors.

rules.statement: No external nitrogen-containing fertilizer may be applied on any agricultural land of the farm.

conditions.expression: farm.compliance.external_n_fertilizer_kg == 0
conditions.description: External nitrogen fertilizer use is zero across the farm.

result.description: The external nitrogen-fertilizer ban is met.

rules.statement: External manure and permitted EU 2018/848 compost may be applied; if slurry is sent to a biogas plant, corresponding biogas slurry may be taken back.

conditions.expression: input type is external manure or permitted compost, or documented biogas return after slurry delivery
conditions.description: The input is one of the expressly permitted exceptions.

result.description: The listed organic input exception applies.

rules.statement: Other organic residues such as potato waste water, maize steep water, Carbokalk, distillery residues and molasses are not permitted.

conditions.expression: organic_residue_type is not in the permitted manure/compost set
conditions.description: The residue is outside the express exceptions.

result.description: The organic residue cannot be used under o6_2.

rules.statement: Non-nitrogen single and compound fertilizers may be used; domestic wastewater may be applied, but sewage sludge is prohibited.

conditions.expression: fertilizer is non-nitrogen or wastewater is own domestic wastewater
conditions.description: The input falls under an expressly stated fertilizer exception.

result.description: The input is allowed only under the stated type restriction.

rules.statement: Annual livestock nitrogen production may not exceed 170 kg N per hectare of agricultural land after stable and storage losses; alpine/community-pasture nitrogen is apportioned out.

conditions.expression: farm.compliance.livestock_n_kg_per_ha <= 170
conditions.description: The current-calendar-year livestock nitrogen production is at or below the threshold.

result.description: The livestock nitrogen threshold is met.

rules.statement: Broadly applied plant-protection products are prohibited on all grassland and arable-fodder areas, except products containing only substances permitted under EU 2018/848 and individual-plant treatment.

conditions.expression: restricted parcel has no prohibited broad application
conditions.description: The parcel is grassland or arable fodder and each application is an allowed bio product or individual treatment.

result.description: The parcel meets the pesticide restriction.

rules.statement: Seed dressing is treated as broad application and is not permitted on restricted grassland or arable-fodder areas.

conditions.expression: restricted parcel.operations.seed_treatment == false
conditions.description: No seed treatment is used on a restricted parcel.

result.description: The seed-treatment restriction is met.

rules.statement: Broadly applied plant-protection products may be used on arable parcels planted with arable crops when permitted by the BAES/AGES register.

conditions.expression: parcel.land_use == arable and parcel is not arable fodder
conditions.description: The parcel is an arable crop parcel outside the grassland/fodder restriction.

result.description: The o6_2 broad-application ban does not apply to this arable crop parcel, subject to the register.

rules.statement: From application year 2026, pesticide applications no longer need to be recorded with PSM codes in the multiple application.

conditions.expression: application_year >= 2026
conditions.description: The application year is 2026 or later.

result.description: The former PSM coding obligation is not required from 2026.

rules.statement: Purchase and storage of inputs prohibited by o6_2 are also prohibited; permitted products used on other crops are exempt if quantities are plausible and documented.

conditions.expression: stored_or_purchased_input is permitted for the relevant crop or is absent
conditions.description: The farm does not buy or store prohibited inputs without a documented other-crop use.

result.description: The purchase and storage rule is met.

rules.statement: At least three hours of specialist training on nitrogen fertilization or adapted grassland use frequency must be completed by 31 December 2025.

conditions.expression: training.hours >= 3 and training.completed_by <= 2025-12-31
conditions.description: The course duration and deadline are met.

result.description: The o6_2 training requirement is fulfilled.

rules.statement: The course must come from an approved provider, may be taken by a materially involved farm person, is countable from 1 January 2022, and cannot be double-counted.

conditions.expression: provider_approved and course_date >= 2022-01-01 and double_counted == false
conditions.description: Provider, date and no-double-counting conditions are met.

result.description: The course can satisfy the measure obligation.

rules.statement: If the trained person leaves before 31 December 2025, the course must be replaced by that date; departure after that date requires no additional course.

conditions.expression: trained_person_departure_date < 2025-12-31
conditions.description: The trained person's departure is tested against the course deadline.

result.description: The training obligation follows the trained person until the deadline.

rules.statement: The separate three-hour biodiversity training obligation under UBB also applies.

conditions.expression: program.o6_1a.participates == true
conditions.description: The required UBB combination is active.

result.description: Three hours of biodiversity-relevant training must also be met under UBB.

rules.statement: The measure must be applied for before the contract starts by 31 December; the last entry was funding year 2025, applied for by 31 December 2024.

conditions.expression: application_date <= 31 December of the year before application_year and application_year in {2023, 2024, 2025}
conditions.description: The initial application deadline and final entry year are met.

result.description: The application establishes a valid o6_2 contract.

rules.statement: A farm-wide combination with organic farming is excluded; only the stated organic partial-farm combination for wine, orchard and hop areas is permitted.

conditions.expression: program.o6_1b is absent or is a permitted partial-farm wine/orchard/hop participation
conditions.description: The organic-farming combination is checked at farm and crop-area level.

result.description: o6_2 and BIO may coexist only in the specified exception.

rules.statement: During the measure period, a switch to organic farming could be made by 31 December 2025 without the normal measure combination.

conditions.expression: switch_date <= 2025-12-31 and target_measure == o6_1b
conditions.description: The conversion deadline and target measure are met.

result.description: The higher-value measure can replace o6_2 for the remaining contract period.

rules.statement: Orchard premium is payable only for high-quality, generally grafted planting material; un-grafted trees must be coded OP and receive no ÖPUL premium.

conditions.expression: orchard planting material is grafted/high-quality
conditions.description: The orchard installation satisfies the planting-material quality requirement.

result.description: The orchard area may receive the measure premium.

rules.statement: For application year 2026 and later through 2028, non-fodder arable and special-crop areas receive 64.8 euros per hectare.

conditions.expression: application_year in {2024, 2025, 2026, 2027, 2028} and parcel is non-fodder arable or eligible special crop
conditions.description: The parcel is in the standard 2024-onward rate class.

result.description: The standard rate is 64.8 euros per hectare before modulation and caps.

rules.statement: For application year 2026 and later, animal-holding fodder/grassland below 1.40 RGVE per hectare receives 75.6 euros per hectare.

conditions.expression: animal_holding and rgve_per_forage_ha < 1.40 and application_year >= 2024
conditions.description: The farm is animal-holding but below the 1.40 RGVE tier.

result.description: The lower animal-holding tier pays 75.6 euros per hectare before modulation and caps.

rules.statement: Non-animal-holding fodder and grassland receive zero premium, while obligations continue to apply; animal status is used only for premium amount.

conditions.expression: rgve_per_forage_ha < 0.30 or animal status is lost in a later year
conditions.description: The farm is not in the animal-holding class for the relevant year.

result.description: The rate is zero for non-animal-holding fodder/grassland, but substantive obligations remain.

rules.statement: Animal-holding fodder/grassland at or above 1.40 RGVE per hectare receives 64.8 euros per hectare from 2024 onward; 2023 rate is 60 euros.

conditions.expression: animal_holding and rgve_per_forage_ha >= 1.40
conditions.description: The farm reaches the upper animal-holding tier.

result.description: The upper tier rate is 64.8 euros per hectare from 2024 onward.

rules.statement: Arable fodder declared as a second crop is paid as arable land and is excluded from fodder-area animal-status calculation.

conditions.expression: parcel is declared as second crop
conditions.description: The parcel has the second-crop declaration.

result.description: The parcel uses the arable premium class and is excluded from fodder-area status calculation.

rules.statement: Only Austrian land and Austrian-held animals count for funded area and animal-density calculations.

conditions.expression: parcel.region.country == AT and animal.holding_country == AT
conditions.description: Funded land and counted animals are located in Austria.

result.description: The location requirement is met.

rules.statement: The o6_2 obligations must be fulfilled for the full calendar-year obligation period and for all funded units.

conditions.expression: all funded parcels comply from 1 January through 31 December
conditions.description: The annual obligation period is fully covered.

result.description: Partial-year compliance is not sufficient unless a stated transfer/exception applies.

rules.statement: For o6_2, 2024 and 2025 area additions are fully premium-eligible; later additions are limited to 50 percent of the 2025 basis, with up to 5 ha always allowed; land already under the same measure is not an addition.

conditions.expression: access_year in {2024, 2025} or later_access <= 50% of 2025 basis or later_access <= 5 ha or same_measure_before == true
conditions.description: The restricted area-access rule is evaluated against the 2025 base.

result.description: The area addition is fully or partially premium-eligible according to the year and cap.

rules.statement: During the multi-year period, area reduction is allowed annually up to 5 percent, at most 5 ha, and in any case 0.50 ha; exceeding the limits triggers repayment for the full difference area.

conditions.expression: reduction <= max(5% of prior_year_measure_area, 0.50 ha) and reduction <= 5 ha
conditions.description: The reduction is within all applicable tolerances.

result.description: The reduction is within tolerance and avoids the specified difference-area repayment.

rules.statement: Access-condition, area, substantive, conditionality or multi-year-period violations can cause premium cuts or repayment; the sanction scale ranges from warning/1 percent from 2027 through 100 percent and exclusion after two 100-percent cuts.

conditions.expression: a listed violation is established
conditions.description: A control identifies a non-compliance event.

result.description: The measure-specific sanction assessment applies.

rules.statement: From 2025, the general cap for the sum of area payments including allocated landscape-element payments is 1,300 euros per hectare.

conditions.expression: sum of relevant area payments per parcel <= 1300 EUR/ha
conditions.description: The parcel's combined area-payment cap is respected.

result.description: The area-payment cap is not exceeded.

rules.statement: The payment is modulated by total farm area: 100 percent through 200 ha, 90 percent over 200 through 300 ha, 85 percent over 300 through 1,000 ha, and 75 percent above 1,000 ha.

conditions.expression: farm.total_area_ha is assigned to the applicable area band
conditions.description: The modulation factor is calculated on the total farm area, subject to the separate alm/behirtung rule.

result.description: The applicable band factor is applied to all measure premiums.

rules.statement: In 2026, on listed drought-district arable parcels with a late-summer/autumn crop and no harvestable stand due to drought, the 85-percent harvest and removal obligation need not be fulfilled and no individual force-majeure report is required; the ÖPUL premium remains payable.

conditions.expression: application_year == 2026 and region.federal_state/district is in data.drought_2026 and parcel is late-summer/autumn crop and no harvestable stand due to drought
conditions.description: All conditions for the automatic 2026 drought exception are met.

result.description: The harvest/removal obligation is waived for the affected parcel in 2026 without individual notification.

rules.statement: In 2026, early use of UBB/BIO biodiversity areas is allowed only with OPUBB or OPBIO coding on the affected area; the affected area receives no UBB/BIO premium and the other maximum-use and remaining obligations remain.

conditions.expression: application_year == 2026 and affected biodiversity parcel is coded OPUBB or OPBIO
conditions.description: The 2026 drought biodiversity exception is used with the required no-premium code.

result.description: The affected UBB/BIO area can be used early but is not paid.

rules.statement: In 2026, grassland biodiversity-area use may be brought forward by 14 days only where OPUBB or OPBIO is coded and no UBB/BIO premium is paid; DIVSZ additionally requires the comparable fields' second cut.

conditions.expression: application_year == 2026 and grassland biodiversity parcel is coded OPUBB or OPBIO and DIVSZ comparable second cut exists
conditions.description: The specific grassland biodiversity exception conditions are met.

result.description: The affected area can be used up to 14 days early without UBB/BIO payment.
